hint_ladder: Apologise before you cut into what someone else is saying.
Use Sorry and then to with the base verb, followed by what you need.
Start with the words: Sorry to ___, but I have a quick question.
teaching_content.reveal_form: Sorry to interrupt, but I have a quick question.
canonical_forms: Sorry to interrupt, but I have a quick question.
alternative_realizations: Sorry for interrupting, but I have a quick question.
